title: Build a Road to Your Lake Cabin
premise: The narrator tells you that driving to your lake cabin twice makes a road, and Leo drives his little car down a dirt track through the pines. Each failure gets a fix that adds a layer to the cross-section. Mud leads to a corduroy log road. Rotting logs leave ruts, so crushed stone goes in and a roller packs it into a compacted base.
